title: Job: Miserable Comforters Are You All

questions.question: What does Job call his friends?
questions.explanation: Job 16:2 (ESV): "I have heard many such things; miserable comforters are you all."

questions.question: Shall what kind of words have an end?
questions.explanation: Job 16:3 (ESV): "Shall windy words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?"

questions.question: If you were in my place, what could I do?
options: Join words together against you/shake my head at you
questions.correctAnswer: Join words together against you/shake my head at you
questions.explanation: Job 16:4 (ESV): "I also could speak as you do, if you were in my place; I could join words together against you and shake my head at you."

questions.question: God has made whom desolate?
questions.explanation: Job 16:7 (ESV): "Surely now God has worn me out; he has made desolate all my company."

questions.question: Who has seized me by the neck and dashed me to pieces?
questions.explanation: Job 16:12 (ESV): "I was at ease, and he broke me apart; he seized me by the neck and dashed me to pieces..."

questions.question: I would strengthen you with my what?
questions.explanation: Job 16:5 (ESV): "I could strengthen you with my mouth, and the solace of my lips would assuage your pain."

questions.question: Men have gaped at me with their what?
questions.explanation: Job 16:10 (ESV): "Men have gaped at me with their mouth; they have struck me insolently on the cheek..."

questions.question: God gives me up to whom?
questions.explanation: Job 16:11 (ESV): "God gives me up to the ungodly and casts me into the hands of the wicked."

questions.question: He sets me up as his what?
questions.explanation: Job 16:12 (ESV): "...he set me up as his target;"

questions.question: Where is my witness?
questions.explanation: Job 16:19 (ESV): "Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and he who testifies for me is on high."

questions.question: My face is red with what?
questions.explanation: Job 16:16 (ESV): "My face is red with weeping, and on my eyelids is deep darkness,"

questions.question: Although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is what?
questions.explanation: Job 16:17 (ESV): "although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure."

questions.question: O earth, cover not my what?
questions.explanation: Job 16:18 (ESV): "O earth, cover not my blood, and let my cry find no resting place."

questions.question: My friends scorn me; my eye pours out tears to whom?
questions.explanation: Job 16:20 (ESV): "My friends scorn me; my eye pours out tears to God,"

questions.question: When a few years have come I shall go the way whence I shall not what?
questions.explanation: Job 16:22 (ESV): "For when a few years have come I shall go the way whence I shall not return."

key_verse_text: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and he who testifies for me is on high.
